thread:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: multi-gpu allreduce failures detected on serving-pool-12 (region-us-west). Error pattern: repeated NCCL timeouts followed by GPU memory growth and container restarts. Auto-escalation to pager.

maria: I'm on it. Seeing a spike in 502/503s for model-route /v1/generate -> routing to fallback pool now. Collecting logs.

ajay: Can you confirm affected models? Any Dedicated customers impacted?

maria: Primarily rwd-13b-optim and a few custom models with pipeline parallel 2/2. Dedicated customers on pool-dedicated-09 saw retries but their reserved capacity was fine; however hosted pool latency spiked.

lee: Sharing quick grep from node logs:```
[2026-03-15T21:10:12Z] NCCL WARN Allreduce timeout on comm 0x7f8bae.. rank 1 -> rank 3
[2026-03-15T21:10:12Z] cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
[2026-03-15T21:10:13Z] container manager: restarting container rwd-13b-runner-4 (oom)
```

sophia: Customer-support, please tag any CI customers on affected routes. We might need to send an incident notice.

customer-support: Notifying top 5 customers on the route now. No billing impact yet; degraded performance only.

ops-bot: Automated mitigation applied: traffic shifted away from serving-pool-12 to serving-pool-08 (capacity check passed). Canary mode enabled for 10% traffic.

maria: Initial hypothesis: NCCL communicator hangs during allreduce when a peer transiently drops (VM network flap). The process doesn't recover cleanly under TP (pipeline parallel) and memory isn't freed, causing OOM. Seen similar but not identical before.

ajay: Can you dump NCCL debug logs and GPU mem stats? Add NCCL_DEBUG=INFO and NCCL_ASYNC_ERROR_HANDLING=1 to the runner env and redeploy a single replica for repro.

maria: Doing that now. Also enabling NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1 as an experiment to bypass NVLINK path. Will collect pmon and nsys as well.

lee: Collected dmesg from node-42:```
[ 1234.567890] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79, pid=14321, gpu=0, reason code 0x0000003b
[ 1234.568012] nvidia-mig: MIG partition report...
```

samir: If this repros in CI, we should fallback to data-parallel variant for that model until we can patch. Switching pipeline->dp will increase tokens/sec cost but keeps availability.

maria: Agreed. For immediate mitigation I'm doing: 1) route live traffic to dp variants where available, 2) restart hung containers with graceful drain 3) enable NCCL_ASYNC_ERROR_HANDLING and log uploads.

ops-bot: Action recorded: INCIDENT-1772003456. Owners assigned: maria (lead), ajay (runtime debug), lee (node diagnostics), sophia (comms). ETA first update in 15m.

sophia: I'll prepare an outbound message for affected customers: brief, what we're doing, ETA.

ajay: For deeper analysis, pls capture pstack of the python process and nvprof/nsys traces before restart if possible. Also capture /var/log/nvidia-installer.log and /tmp/nccl_net_debug.*.

maria: Got a pstack from one hung process:```
#0  0x00007f8b... ncclAllReduce (in libnccl.so)
#1  0x00007f7c... run_pipeline_step (runner.cpp:412)
#2  0x00007f6d... serve_loop (server.cpp:88)
#3  0x00005555... main (/app/bin/runner)
```

lee: Node-level observation: network interface eth1 had a brief SR-IOV flit error around the time of the first timeout. Hypervisor reported transient link bounce on host. We're correlating with cloud provider logs.

customer-support: Customers updated: "We're investigating a multi-GPU runtime issue affecting a subset of hosted models. We've applied routing mitigations and expect reduced impact within 30 minutes."

ajay: A few notes from runtime runs: 1) NCCL 2.16 had a fix for communicator reinit but we run 2.15 on serving-pool-12. 2) When rank restarts during in-flight collectives and the slot reuse happens, the communicator can end up in a state where pending ops never complete and memory pages remain pinned.

maria: Repro attempt on a staged node: triggered a simulated link drop -> rank 2 crashed -> others entered allreduce hang and memory climbed steadily. Confirmed.

samir: OK mitigation plan: short-term (minutes): route away, restart hung containers, flip models to dp. mid-term (hours): roll nccl upgrade to 2.16 on affected pools, enable async error handling by default for TP models, add watchdog to kill/restart stuck collectives. long-term: improve graceful communicator reinit and operator-level timeout handling.

ops-bot: Temporary runbook snippet attached: ```
- detect: nccl timeout pattern, gpu oom logs
- mitigate: redirect traffic + canary to unaffected pool
- if stuck: set NCCL_ASYNC_ERROR_HANDLING=1 and restart runner
- fallback: switch pipeline->data-parallel variant
- collect: pstack, nsys, dmesg, /tmp/nccl_* logs, upload to s3://infra-incidents/1772003456/
```

lee: Uploaded node diagnostics to s3://infra-incidents/1772003456/nodes/node-42.tar.gz

maria: Rolling a canary build with NCCL 2.16 build + NCCL_ASYNC_ERROR_HANDLING=1 on serving-pool-12 candidate nodes. Monitoring memory and collector metrics.

sophia: Updating customers with ETA: Rolling mitigations now, full mitigation in 2-4 hours pending nccl rollout.

ajay: One more actionable: add per-collective op timeout metric to runtime so we can alert before OOM. I'll open a ticket and include a small patch for 10s default op timeout.

maria: Current status at +30m: traffic shifted, error rate down from 6% -> 1.2% on the original route. No new OOM restarts in last 10m on canary. Will keep monitoring.

ops-bot: Next update scheduled at +60m. If any owner needs immediate help react with :pager:.

customer-support: Will prepare a short post-incident note once root cause confirmed and NCCL rollouts scheduled.

lee: Provider confirmed a network micro-flap affecting a NIC on host group 65 between 21:09:30-21:10:00Z. That lines up with the first allreduce hang.

maria: Root cause summary (working): transient host NIC flap -> rank drop mid-collective -> NCCL 2.15 communicator hang causing pinned GPU memory and container OOMs under pipeline parallel workloads.

sophia: Assigning follow-ups: TICKET-INC-1772003456-1 (nccl upgrade plan) -> ajay; TICKET-INC-1772003456-2 (watchdog + op-timeout) -> maria; TICKET-INC-1772003456-3 (customer postmortem) -> sophia.

ajay: I'll start the nccl upgrade on a small cohort and validate perf. If stable, we'll schedule broader rollout tonight with a staged window.

maria: Thanks team. Closing pager after next monitoring window if no regressions.

oncall-bot: Pager closed by maria at 1772003620. Incident moved to postmortem backlog. :white_check_mark:
